summary: Learn DevOps for ERP deployment, testing, configuration, and audit governance. Build practical pipelines and release controls. Enrol today.
lede: DevOps for ERP and core transaction systems applies DevOps principles to ERP transports and customisations (SAP, Oracle or similar), infrastructure changes, testing evidence, and approval decisions. The course connects ITIL 4, COBIT, DORA metrics, and practical release evidence to help teams create delivery workflows that are tested, approved, traceable, and ready to roll back. You will map ERP release flows, assess deployment risk, automate repeatable tests, manage configuration changes, and report release performance to governance stakeholders. Through hands-on pipeline and governance design, you will work with Git-based promotion rules, Jenkins or GitLab CI/CD stages, Ansible configuration baselines, risk-based test selection, and evidence packs for controlled releases.
audienceIntro: DevOps for ERP is designed for professionals who connect enterprise application delivery, infrastructure operations, release control, and audit assurance. It suits intermediate practitioners who can describe their current environment and want a structured method for improving it without requiring software development expertise.
modules: Automated ERP Testing and Quality Gates
ERP Release Governance and Audit Evidence
ERP DevOps Roadmap and Executive Reporting
prerequisites: You should have working experience with an ERP or core business system, IT operations, release coordination, software testing, infrastructure administration, or internal audit. Familiarity with any ERP, change records, or CI/CD concepts helps, but advanced programming is not required. Coding or programming is not required for completion. Exercises focus on workflow design, configuration logic, evidence mapping, and operational decision-making rather than production deployment. Advanced topics such as Git-based ERP change transport (SAP gCTS or equivalent), AI-assisted test analysis, and hybrid-cloud automation receive conceptual awareness or operational application treatment, not technical engineering depth.
